design_hypotheses: Use a solvable visual fault immediately, with enough information to make one answer defensible.
Make reading and answering easy with four short consistent options.
Test a short 10-18 second version with voice, avoiding long acronym/date readings.
Ask for the diagnostic clue, rather than demanding arbitrary comments.
Preserve the visual puzzle, then show the fix; compare performance against our own posts.

Score-based participation may be worth testing later; it is not evidence that five questions outperform a single puzzle.
